mapper.select: SELECT workorder_id FROM pro_workorder WHERE workorder_id = #{workorderId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT operation_id, action_type, workorder_id, actor_id, request_digest, result_ref, committed_at FROM pro_execution_operation WHERE operation_id = #{operationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pro_execution_operation (operation_id, action_type, workorder_id, actor_id, request_digest) VALUES (#{operationId}, #{actionType}, #{workorderId}, #{actorId}, #{requestDigest})
mapper.update: UPDATE pro_execution_operation SET result_ref = #{resultRef}, committed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE operation_id = #{operationId} AND committed_at IS NULL AND result_ref IS NULL
